excerpts.text: # 安全加固遗留问题 — 已完成（2026-08-25）
> 来源：2026-08-12/08-13 两轮全仓安全加固（191 files, +12k）提交前的独立复查。
> 2026-08-25 复核并完成余下 8 项：统一 manifest 安全读取、拒绝点号名称假成功、
> undo/redo 会话与窗口校验、撤销设备防复活、browser anchor 生命周期清理、
> DeliveryQueue 逐记录清理重试与锁外附件下载、user scope fail-closed。
> 本文件移入 archive，以下保留修复前的问题与验收依据。
### 2. 带点号的插件/Skill 名会静默 no-op 却报告成功
名字被插进点分设置键 `capabilityOverrides.plugins.${plugin}`；
期望扁平 `Record<name,"on"|"off">`，非法结构被归一化为 inherit。
- 结果：`disable plugin a.b` 返回「Disabled ...」但插件依然启用。
- 建议：禁止名字中的 `.`，或改用非点分的键写入方式。

statusInterpretation: Original heading says completed on 2026-08-25 and that the archive preserves pre-fix issues/acceptance basis. It explicitly mentions rejecting dotted names. Section 2 names plugin/Skill inputs and recommends either rejecting dots or a non-dotted key write. This dated status does not establish that the currently read MCP/project-override variant is fixed, nor that all current settings mechanisms are defective.
coverageLimitation: One personally read original archive, not an independent full-history scan. Parent supplied the candidate to compare; no mutable/final prep155 report was read.
